title: CNN SOTA parity + SHAP-seeded GA init + Venn-Abers on Random Forest

sota_benchmark.paper: Machine Learning for Basketball Game Outcomes: NBA and WNBA Leagues
sota_benchmark.note: CPU-only constraint prevents CNN on islands — focus on calibration to match

our_fleet_position.assessment: AT or ABOVE published SOTA — our historical best (0.22073) already beats CNN (0.221)

proposals.description: S18 live best uses random_forest (0.22154). S22 historical best used venn_abers_fusion (0.22073). Apply Venn-Abers calibration wrapper to S18 random_forest — highest-probability path to breaking 0.22073 since both components are individually proven.

proposals.technique: SHAP-guided feature warm-start for stagnant islands
proposals.description: Stagnant islands S14/S15/S22 stuck in local optima. SHAP analysis shows FG%, def_rebounds, turnovers consistently top. Inject these as mandatory seeds in the next diversify reset — override random init with SHAP-ranked top-20 features from S18's best model.

proposals.technique: ExtraTrees + Venn-Abers as new model type
proposals.description: S14 had extra_trees breakthrough at Brier=0.2200. S15 hit 0.21973 with random_forest 200 features. Adding extra_trees_venn_abers as a dedicated model_type in the GA mutation pool could unlock sub-0.220 territory on CPU.

cross_project_port.nba_to_political: S15 random_forest breakthrough (0.21973) + S18 random_forest live best suggest this model type is underexplored in political islands. Political islands dominated by xgboost/logistic/lightgbm. Propose adding random_forest to political GA mutation pool.

next_action: Implement P1-venn-abers-rf in S18 hf-space/app.py — lowest effort, highest expected ROI
